description: Asks how an undeclared name in a WHERE clause is classified when it is spelt like a host-application reference or a built-in: [x y], x.y, [x.y], x!y, Forms!F!C in three bracket spellings, TempVars!x, Screen.ActiveForm.Name, Reports![R]![C], CurrentUser with and without parentheses and brackets, Me.x, Date, Now and Rnd bare and bracketed, Null and True bracketed, a column name bracketed, a function call that does not exist and the same in brackets, and a string literal. For each a temporary QueryDef over Dm is created, its Parameters (Name, Type, Direction) are read and a snapshot is opened without assigning anything, with DBEngine.Errors read; nothing can prompt, because DAO reports an unresolved name as an error. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [x y];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = x.y;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [x.y];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = x!y;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Forms]![F]![C];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Forms!F!C;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Forms]![F]!C;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = TempVars!x;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [TempVars]![x];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Screen.ActiveForm.Name;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Reports![R]![C];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = CurrentUser;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = CurrentUser();
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [CurrentUser];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Me.x;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Me].x;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Date;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Date];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Now;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Now];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Rnd;
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Rnd];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Null];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [True];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [ID];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Dm.ID];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Dm].[ID];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = NoSuch(1);
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [NoSuch(1)];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = 'NoSuch';
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [NoSuch].[ID];
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Dm]![NoSuch];
